2555 Jameson Canyon Road
American Canyon, CA 94503

Our Open Air Photo Booth

Providing 20 lights. Magenta Purple for inside and Green for outside/Inside. Gobo.

3x spotlight for Sweetheart table, Initials on Ceiling.

Punjabi & American Wedding

Mr & Mrs Heberer – May 25th 2014

Photo Booth

 

Chardonnay Golf Club
Napa Valley, North Bay Area, California.

2 mics, tv screen. 1 lapel mic.

Gobo initials on Wall floor.
Name on Photo Booth
Photo Booth , 7-11pm
20 lights. Magenta Purple for inside and Green for outside.

Song List

This is the correct order
1. sajde ke hai laakhon
2. aye ho meri zindagi (hindi lady singer)
3. The first dance song is Lucky (Jason Mraz and Colbie Calleat)
4. Father daughter dance is Akele Hum Akele Tum
5. Mother Son Dance- I’ll Always Love My Mama

Ceremony:

Processional:
1. Two is Better Than One- Boys Like Girls ft. Taylor Swift
2. Young and Beautiful- Lana Del Rey (The Great Gatsby Soundtrack)

Bride Entrance:
1. Only Hope- Switchfoot (A Walk to Remember Soundtrack)

Candle Ceremony:
1. You Light Up My Life- LeAnn Rimes

Sand Ceremony:
1. Inside Your Heaven- Carrie Underwood

End of Christian Ceremony:
1. Treasure- Bruno Mars

Between Christian Ceremony and Hindu Ceremony:
1. Sajde Ki Yeh Hai Laakhoin- Khatta Meetha (cd 1)

Bride Entrance (Hindu Ceremony)
1. Aaye Ho Meri Zindagi- Raja Hindustani (cd 2)

End of Hindu Ceremony:
1. Hey Shona- Ta Ra Rum Pum

Reception:

Introduction of Bridal Party:
1. Applause- Lady Gaga

VN & Kusum Goswami- Grandparents of the Bride
Sanjay & Rajni Goswami- Parents of the Bride
John & Martha Heberer- Parents of the Groom
Ryan Conklin, Daniel Berkowitz & Adidev Rooprai- Ushers and Ringbearer
Akshay Kashyap & Serena O’Dierno- Groomsman & Bridesmaid
Brian Heberer & Lipika Agrawal- Groomsman & Bridesmaid
Andrew Schellhammer & Caitlin Heberer- Groomsman & Bridesmaid
Ankur Goswami & Patricia Romero- Groomsman & Maid of Honor
Jeffrey Hicks & Brittney Kern- Best Man & Maid of Honor

Introduction of Bride and Groom:
1. Love You Like A Love Song- Selena Gomez

Mr. & Mrs. Nicholas Heberer- Bride and Groom

Bride/Groom First Dance:
1. Lucky (Jason Mraz and Colbie Calleat) send CD 3

Cake Cutting:
1. Today Was a Fairytale- Taylor Swift

Father/Daughter Dance:
1. Akele Hum Akele Tum- Akele Hum Akele Tum (CD 4)

Mother/Son Dance:
1. I’ll Always Love My Mama- Intruders (CD 5)

Indian Dance Performance:
1. Will provide song

Bouquet Toss:
1. L.O.V.E.- Ashlee Simpson

Garter Retrieval:
1. Bump and Grind- R. Kelly

Garter Toss:
1. Bad Boys- Inner Circle

Dholi:
1. Nagada Sang Dhol- Gooliyon ke RaasLeela- Ram Leela

In da Club- 50 Cent

1. Everybody (Backstreet’s Back) – Backstreet Boys
2. Beware of the Boys- Panjabi MC
3. Love Mera Hit Hit- Billu Barber
4. Bye Bye Bye- N’Sync
5. California Gurls- Katy Perry ft. Snoop Dog
6. Yeah!- Usher ft. Lil Jon & Ludacris
7. Paisa- De Dana Dan
8. Subha Hone Na De- Desi Boyz
9. Discowale Khisko (Remix)- Dil Bole hadippa
10. Glad You Came- The Wanted
11. Shout
12. Get Low- Lil Jon & The East Side Boys
13. Call me Maybe- Carly Rae Jepsen
14. Ni**as in Paris- Kanye West
15. Wannabe- Spice Girls
16. Jugni- Tanu Weds Manu
17. Before he Cheats- Carrie Underwood
18. Crank Dat- Soulja Boy
19. Dark Horse- Katy Perry
20. Amplifier- Imran Khan
21. Rum Whiskey- Vicky Donor
22. Feelin’ Myself- Will.i.am ft. Miley Cyrus
Mix of English, Hindi and Panjabi music.
